>> They need to submit a proposal through the program website - see

> Many thanks fro your reply. How is this linked to our proposals? Are
> they offered a list with all the R-related proposals that we have made?
> Apparently they have to present their own proposals and I am missing the

There is no link - except that they must specify the R project as
their mentoring organisation, and if their proposal doesn't match any
of our proposals and no one is signed up to mentor it, then it won't
get funded.

I have registered as a Student at http://www.google-melange.com/gsoc/profile/student/google/gsoc2011 and after selecting 'R' with keyword 'statistics' I was presented with the following http://www.google-melange.com/gsoc/org/google/gsoc2011/rproject, and a link to submit a proposal to R, although I have not yet submitted my proposal as I am just finishing it up.
